tap.link: Link this chip to a card

unassigned.title: This chip isn't linked yet
unassigned.body: It's a genuine Vertex Connect chip, but no card is linked to it yet, or its card isn't published. If it's yours, sign in and link it, and the next tap will open your card.

disabled.title: This chip is turned off
disabled.body: Its owner has switched this chip off, so it doesn't open a card any more. If you were handed it, ask them for their card another way.

unknown.title: This chip isn't active
unknown.body: It isn't a chip issued by Vertex Connect, or it has been removed from its workspace.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email.
verifyEmail.body: We sent a link to {{email}}. You'll need it to invite your team or choose a plan.
verifyEmail.sent: A new link is on its way to {{email}}. Check your spam folder too.
verifyEmail.notSent: The email couldn't be sent. Try again in a moment.
